تنتهكن (form VIII)
# تَنْتَهِكْنَ (tantahikna) /tan.ta.hik.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past active indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
# تُنْتَهَكْنَ (tuntahakna) /tun.ta.hak.na/: second-person feminine plural non-past passive indicative/subjunctive/jussive of اِنْتَهَكَ (intahaka)
